_comment: 10 varied opening greetings, for UI-side rotation on session start. Not consumed by sync-agent.ts — the ElevenLabs agent-level config only holds one static first_message, so true per-call variety has to come from the caller (UI). Pick one at random and pass it as a session-start override.
_how_to_use: JS SDK: Conversation.startSession({ overrides: { agent: { firstMessage: pickRandom(intros) } } }). Widget: override-first-message="..." attribute. Requires overrides to be enabled in the agent's Security settings in the ElevenLabs dashboard, or the override is silently ignored.
_why: first_message is spoken immediately at call start, before the caller says anything — it's what keeps the caller from sitting in silence while the session spins up. Rotating it avoids every caller hearing an identical scripted opener, which reads as more natural on repeat/demo use.
_tone_note: Keep additions short, plain, and low-pressure — matches prompt.md's Noor persona and C's tested tone. Scope is Dubai's information line specifically (open data, statistics, DEWA tariffs, accessibility services), not generic 'UAE services' — entry 1 is C's exact tested first_message from MCPServer/agent-prompt.md, verified working end to end; the rest are new variants in the same voice and scope.

Hi! Ask me anything about living in Dubai — utilities, getting around, or what the city publishes data on. What's on your mind?
Hello, I can help with Dubai services and data — bills, accessibility, getting around. What would you like to know?

Welcome to Dubai's information line. Bills, getting around, accessibility, city data — what brings you here today?

Hi — feel free to ask me about living in Dubai, from bills to accessible services to what the city's data says.
